visual_inspection.interpretation: The local pages are clean, readable and finished but less visually ambitious. The Antigravity score applies to its stale first page and does not credit durable follow-up or offline behavior.

antigravity_agriculture_baseline.offline_failure: external Tailwind, Chart.js, icon and font requests were required; Chart was undefined when blocked

limitations: Q4 did not meet the 85% standalone gate.
The routed 30/30 result is a replay over saved Q4 outputs plus a separately qualified Qwen fallback, not a repeated end-to-end 30-case service run.
Qwen 3.8 27B was called through OpenRouter; local DGX replay remains required before claiming private deployment.
Arctic quantized inference was run with CUDA llama.cpp on this host, not on a representative Windows laptop or CPU-only laptop.
Scanned PDFs, arbitrary workbook region correction, public-data discovery and citations need additional product journeys.
Twenty-user concurrency and Windows packaging were not tested.
The existing 2B/9B Algebra LoRAs were assessed as domain-specific architecture evidence, not live-qualified as generic arbitrary-table planners.
